generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: assign sequential 1..N (offset past any compact keys) in table order before sampling any other column; never NULL; PKs are finalized before any foreign-key draw and never mutated afterwards; PK-formula checks are assertions only, never applied to random samples
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: copy an existing final parent key; child count per parent varies (some 0, some duplicated); never NULL unless column nullable
generic_sampling_rules.text_foreign_key: copy the final parent key rendered as str(); never NULL unless column nullable
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: integer in [0, 100000]; occasionally 0 and small values
generic_sampling_rules.short_enum_text: pick from column exception enum when listed, otherwise title-case word of 3-15 chars; allow near-duplicate variant with 10% share
generic_sampling_rules.short_label_text: distinct title-case phrase of 2-4 words; allow duplicates and near-variants
generic_sampling_rules.numeric_coercion: numeric columns (INT/REAL/NUMERIC) are always sampled by a numeric sampler; _apply_formulas coerces operands and skips/redraws non-numeric values before comparison; a single bad value never aborts an instance
generic_sampling_rules.exact_row_count: every table is finalized to exactly table_sizes_per_instance[t] generated rows after all transforms (PK dedup, group sizes, duplicates, ties, aggregate rebalance); transforms that drop rows refill to the target; compact rows are kept verbatim and counted separately
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: for every nullable column (schema NOT NULL flag false and not part of the PK) plant at least one NULL row per instance with a share following the compact DB (5% default); plant_nulls must run for every nullable column including phone_market.Num_of_stock; aggregate rebalance never overwrites planted NULLs; rules and formulas constrain only non-NULL operands

targets.scope: generated rows only; compact rows preserved and excluded; re-verified after all post-processing; rebalance touches non-null indices only
